_comment: Privacy-safe notices for the coursework demo. Course-specific evaluation information comes from the user's evaluation notice; other service notices are fictional.

notices.title: Web Programming project evaluation
notices.body: Project evaluation is scheduled for 24 September 2026. All group members should be available. The presentation duration is 15 minutes and students should be prepared for viva, demonstration and small live code updates.

notices.title: Attendance eligibility reminder
notices.body: The demo attendance intelligence uses 80% as the Internal Examination threshold and 75% as the Main ESE threshold, as provided for this project.

notices.title: Odd semester teaching period nearing completion
notices.body: The original academic calendar marked 30 September 2026 as the semester end, but regular S5 teaching has been extended through 9 October 2026.

notices.title: Library service demo notice
notices.body: This is a fictional service notice included only to demonstrate notice filtering and rendering in the student portal.
